subject: Infosec alignment: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & DPA next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@kitebank.com>, KiteBank Security Team <security@kitebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Infosec alignment: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & DPA next steps

Hi Daniel / KiteBank team —

Thanks for carving out time today. Short recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we can keep momentum.

Key goals we heard you today:
- Shortlist a production-safe config for payment flows within 6 weeks.
- Confirm DPA language and retention windows to satisfy internal auditors.
- Validate SOC 2 controls and audit-log access for your compliance team.

Primary pain points / constraints you called out:
1) Audit log retention must be >=12 months and searchable by transaction id.
2) Data residency preference: US-only production for payments; EMEA for analytics only.
3) Independent pen test report required before go-live, and a defined window for Redwood to coordinate a remediation plan.

What Redwood can provide now:
- High-level SOC 2 summary (attached: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf) showing scope and last attestation date.
- Default audit log retention is configurable; we can do 12 months by policy.
- We maintain an incident timeline and audit access logs with role-based access and KMS-backed encryption.

Requested artifacts from KiteBank (so we can map acceptance criteria):
- Completed security DDQ or prioritized DDQ questions (attach if you can)
- Preferred DPA template or markups for legal review
- Any specific pen-test scope items you require (e.g., exfiltration scenarios, red-team style tests)

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) You send DDQ + DPA redlines by 2024-05-14.
2) Redwood (Markus + Security) replies with technical responses and draft counters by 2024-05-17.
3) Joint security design review (45m) the week of 2024-05-20 to lock scope for pen test.
4) Target pen-test window: June 10–21 (flexible; depends on scope).

Can you confirm the timeline and deliverables above? If that works I’ll drop a calendar invite for the design review and attach a MAP template.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (high-level), sample MAP template (will send if you confirm).

Best,
So-
So-
SoSojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

On a related note: I copied Marissa who will help coordinate artifact exchanges and legal touches.

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@kitebank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: KiteBank Security Team <security@kitebank.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2024 13:40:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Infosec alignment: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & DPA next steps

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear summary. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying questions:

1) We can provide an initial DDQ (I’ll attach a partial export of our questionnaire) — expect that by EOD Tuesday (2024-05-14).
2) DPA: our legal team will try to push a redline set by Thursday; if you have a short-form DPA that maps retention clauses already, send it over and we can start there.
3) Regarding pen tests: we require (a) a list of endpoints to be tested, (b) a remediation SLA expectation, and (c) whether Redwood supports staged re-tests.

Two technical clarifications from our infra team:
- Audit logs must be queryable for 18 months for regulatory reporting — is 18 months feasible?
- We need assurance that audit logs cannot be deleted by engineers without an auditable approval path. Does Redwood support immutable retention with approval workflows?

I’m attaching our partial DDQ export (kitebank_security_ddq_v1.pdf) — it’s a subset but shows the areas they care about.

If the MAP timeline you proposed is tight, we can shift the design review to the week of 2024-05-27.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Product Security | KiteBank
daniel.park@kitebank.com

--
Attachment: kitebank_security_ddq_v1.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@kitebank.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2024 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Infosec alignment: SOC 2, audit logs, retention & DPA next steps

Daniel —

Thanks for the DDQ extract, and good questions. I’m Redwood’s product security lead and I’ll address the technical points you raised. High level answers below; we can expand in the design review.

1) Retention: We support configurable retention policies up to 3 years. 18 months is fully supported and we can enable a retention policy scoped to the payment logs index only. We will provide a retention configuration doc and sample queries for your auditors.

2) Immutable / approval workflow: We support append-only audit logs with administrative controls. Deletions require a documented approval process that is recorded in the audit trail (ticket ID + approver). We can integrate with your ticketing system (Jira) for automated gating if you want.

3) Pen test scope & re-tests: Redwood will provide a testable endpoint inventory and a standard remediation SLA (30 days for critical, 60 days for high/medium) — we can commit to one complimentary re-test for critical fixes if the scope is within the agreed test window.

4) Encryption & KMS: All at-rest data is KMS-encrypted. We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated/private deployments.

Next concrete actions from Redwood security:
- I’ll attach a short technical appendix with retention config examples and an audit-query sample by Monday (2024-05-13).
- We’ll prepare the endpoint inventory for pen-test scoping ahead of the design review.

Marissa — can you own assembling the MAP workbook and a shared Drive folder for artifacts?

Regards,
Markus Klein
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
